_comment: The example endpoints file. Copy to <helm home>/_global/endpoints.json and
edit: this file is documentation and is never read at runtime. A seat
family whose host is the operator's own box names a key here (its pool row
carries `base_url_from`), so the source holds no LAN host and re-pointing
the family is an edit of this file, read on every call with no restart.
Each value is the OpenAI-compatible base URL, ending before
/chat/completions. A keyless family may use plain http only to a literal
private or loopback address; any other host must be https.
While a family's key is missing, that family is unavailable: `helm seat
add` refuses and names this file and the key, and its route binds no
proof. Only the keys a pool row names are read, so this comment is inert.
